verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only web search tools, downloadable bulk data (IP Horizons) and account-based online services. Nothing shows documented API endpoints, a key-issuance path or stated rate limits. Bulk downloads are a different capability from a public API, so they earn no credit; a public API is a fair ask for an IP office's data service, so the axis applies.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
